DMD_Haslett <- read.csv("DMD-HaslettData.csv")
rownames(DMD_Haslett)<-c(DMD_Haslett[,1])
DMD_Haslett[,1:2]<-NULL
DMD <- DMD_Haslett[,1:12]
NOR <- DMD_Haslett[,13:24]
library(MVN)
mvn(DMD_Haslett)
DMD_Haslett_DEG <- NULL
for (row in 1:nrow(DMD_Haslett)){
  test <- t.test(t(DMD[row,]), t(NOR[row,]))
  #print(shapiro.test(as.numeric(DMD_Haslett[row,])))
  pvalue <- p.adjust(test$p.value, method = "fdr", n = nrow(DMD_Haslett))
  if (pvalue <0.05){
    if (cor(t(DMD[row,]), t(NOR[row,])) > 0){
      DEG <- cbind(rownames(DMD_Haslett[row,]), as.numeric(pvalue),"+")
    }else{
      DEG <- cbind(rownames(DMD_Haslett[row,]), as.numeric(pvalue),"-")
    }
    DMD_Haslett_DEG <- rbind(DMD_Haslett_DEG, DEG)
  }
}

DMD_Pescatori_DEG <- NULL
for (row in 1:nrow(DMD_Pescatori)){
  ttest <- t.test(t(DMD[row,]), t(NOR[row,]))
  pvalue <- p.adjust(ttest$p.value, method = "fdr", n = nrow(DMD_Pescatori))
  if (pvalue <0.05){
    if (cor(t(DMD[row,]), t(NOR[row,])) > 0){
      DEG <- cbind(rownames(DMD_Pescatori[row,]),"+")
    }else{
      DEG <- cbind(rownames(DMD_Pescatori[row,]),"-")
    }
    DMD_Pescatori_DEG <- rbind(DMD_Pescatori_DEG, DEG)
  }
}
